concerns.text: FR-001 references a NIST Materials Data Repository DOI but the DOI is left blank ("DOI "). Without a concrete identifier the system cannot be verified to retrieve material properties, making the requirement untestable.

The ‘Verified Datasets’ block lists the OpenML URL as `https://www.openml.org/d/` with no dataset identifier, and FR-001 cites OpenML ID 42123. The missing identifier prevents any reviewer or test harness from locating the dataset, rendering related FRs and SCs unverifiable.

FR-011 requires validation against a “curated literature lookup table” that is never defined or provided in the spec. Without the table, the sign‑matching check cannot be performed, so the requirement is not verifiable.
